text: Implemented on local main d9b578d: CompositionOptions.withRowHeights(Vector[RowHeight]) (points | weight) + withSharedXFrame(true) check (panel x range and x scale domain). Evidence: CompositionRowHeightSuite 7/7 JVM (+JS): 45pt strip / weighted matrix / 90pt contrast panels over a shared BandScaleSpec x have bit-identical panel x and width; cell heights exact; band discs at identical device x in all three rows; per-row strips let an axis-free 45pt row compose; mismatched x levels refused; invalid specs refused; equal weights == default. JavaFX and SVG consume the same device scene; no separate native screenshot taken. Note: a row with a full x axis at 96 ppi needs > 60pt (strip 80.3px) - LayoutOverflow, by design.
